cases.note: An arm bolted to a bench and run off mains. §36.1 has four states and all four assume a battery; this is the fifth, and it grants leases, because a body with no pack is not a body in trouble.
A body that declares a pack and got nothing back. Not critical — missing evidence is never a positive finding — and not normal either: no new lease until something answers for the pack.
